[EN] Good gracious! Who could have imagined that such a place would be down here...? And it doesn't seem to be natural...

I wonder how this place got here...

Don't worry. I'll try to stay out of your way.
[ES] ¡Dios mío! ¿Quién habría imaginado que un lugar así estaría aquí abajo...? Y no parece ser natural...

Me pregunto cómo llegó este lugar aquí...

No te preocupes. Intentaré no estorbar.

[EN] Look at this place! It doesn't seem...natural.
[ES] ¡Mira este lugar! No parece... natural.

[EN] It looks like there's a way down over there. Go ahead, I'll be right behind you.
[ES] Parece que hay una forma de bajar por ahí. Ve tú, te sigo de cerca.
